title: 01. Foundations: QLoRA — Quantized LoRA
summary: QLoRA = NF4 Quantization + LoRA + Double Quantization + Paged Optimizers. It brings fine-tuning a 65B model down to a single 48GB GPU — tasks that previously needed 8× A100s.

sections.title: What Is QLoRA?
sections.body: > **QLoRA = NF4 Quantization + LoRA + Double Quantization + Paged Optimizers. It brings fine-tuning a 65B model down to a single 48GB GPU — tasks that previously needed 8× A100s.**

sections.title: QLoRA — All 4 Innovations
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              QLoRA's 4 KEY INNOVATIONS                          │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  INNOVATION 1: 4-BIT NF4 BASE MODEL
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Load the ENTIRE base model in 4-bit NF4 quantization.
  FROZEN — never updated during training.

  7B model: 14 GB (FP16) → 3.5 GB (NF4) ← 4x smaller!

  But wait — can you train with 4-bit weights?
  Answer: Yes! With a trick:
  NF4 stored in 4-bit
  DEQUANTIZED to BF16 for the forward pass computation
  Gradient flows through the BF16 computation
  Only LoRA adapter weights (small) are updated

  INNOVATION 2: DOUBLE QUANTIZATION
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Already covered in quantization lesson:
  Quantize the quantization scale factors too.
  Saves ~0.37 bits per weight = ~3.5 GB for 65B model.

  INNOVATION 3: PAGED OPTIMIZERS
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Problem: Optimizer states (Adam: 2× param size) still huge.
           Even LoRA optimizer states can spike GPU memory.
           Memory spikes can crash training (OOM errors).

  Solution: NVIDIA Unified Memory (paged memory)
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Optimizer states stored in CPU RAM                      │
  │  Only moved to GPU when needed for gradient update       │
  │  Like virtual memory for GPUs                            │
  │                                                          │
  │  GPU RAM:  model weights + activations (always hot)      │
  │  CPU RAM:  optimizer states (paged in/out as needed)     │
  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  Prevents OOM crashes during long training runs. ✅

  INNOVATION 4: COMPUTE IN BF16
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Store: NF4 (4-bit, tiny size)
  Compute: BF16 (16-bit, fast and accurate)

  This is the magic combination:
  Storage efficiency of 4-bit +
  Computational stability of BF16 = best of both worlds

  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  QLoRA MEMORY BREAKDOWN (7B model, batch=4):
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  ┌────────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────┐
  │  Component                         │  Memory            │
  ├────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────┤
  │  Base model (NF4 4-bit)            │   3.5 GB           │
  │  LoRA adapters (r=16, BF16)        │   0.1 GB           │
  │  Activations + forward pass (BF16) │   6.0 GB           │
  │  Gradients (LoRA only, BF16)       │   0.1 GB           │
  │  Paged optimizer states            │   0.2 GB (GPU)     │
  │                                    │  +4.0 GB (CPU RAM) │
  ├────────────────────────────────────┼────────────────────┤
  │  TOTAL GPU:                        │  ~10 GB ✅          │
  │  Fits on: RTX 3080 10GB!           │                    │
  └────────────────────────────────────┴────────────────────┘

  COMPARISON:
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  Method          GPU Memory     Hardware
  ─────────────── ──────────     ──────────────────────────────
  Full FT (7B)    122 GB         2× A100 80GB ($32/hr)
  LoRA (7B FP16)   24 GB         RTX 4090 24GB ($0.50/hr)
  QLoRA (7B NF4)   10 GB         RTX 3080 10GB ($0.20/hr)
  QLoRA (65B NF4)  48 GB         A100 40GB ($2/hr) ← incredible!
```
